Loom price is Loom Business, billed monthly, $18 per person per month, checked November 2026. Storage runs on Cloudflare’s free tier (10 GB). Beyond that, Cloudflare bills your own account about $0.015 per GB each month.

Questions, answered.

Do I need a Cloudflare account?

Yes, a free one, and connecting it is just one click. Sign in to Cloudflare, press Allow, and we handle the rest: your storage, database and video address are set up for you in about 30 seconds. Nothing to configure, no keys to copy. No Cloudflare account yet? Signing up is free.

Can Showthrough see the rest of my Cloudflare account?

No. Here’s exactly where the line is.What we keep: your Cloudflare account ID and name, the names and address of the storage, database and video app we created, and an upload key. That key only works with the Showthrough video app in your account, so our website can show your library and the extension can upload.What we don’t keep: the access Cloudflare gives us when you press Allow (or Update). We use it for about 30 seconds to set up or update the Showthrough parts, then throw it away, so afterwards we can’t reach anything else in your account.What we never see: your Cloudflare password, your card and billing, your websites, domains and DNS, or your other Workers, storage and databases. Cloudflare doesn’t give us access to your password, card, websites or DNS at all, and we never open anything we didn’t create.

Will Cloudflare charge me?

Cloudflare asks for a card before it turns on storage, but you pay nothing while you stay within the free tier: 10 GB of storage, and viewing is always free. That's a lot of screen recordings. Past 10 GB it's about $0.015 per GB a month, billed by Cloudflare.

Where are my videos stored?

In a private storage bucket in your own Cloudflare account. You connect it in one click and we handle the rest. Our servers never store your recordings. Share links play through a fast cache so videos start quickly for viewers anywhere.

Who can watch my videos?

Anyone you send the link to. Viewers don’t need an account. Password-protected and private links are on the roadmap.

Does it work on Windows and Chromebooks?

Yes. Showthrough is a Chrome extension, so it works anywhere Chrome runs: Mac, Windows, Linux and ChromeOS.

Why are there three prices?

Our first buyers paid $29. Our Black Friday price is $49 until Black Friday, 27 November, 11:59 PM PT, and both include every future update, forever. After that the price is $99, and that purchase covers the version you buy without future updates. Whatever you buy keeps working.

Is it a subscription?

No. You pay once and your whole team can use it. The only other cost is Cloudflare storage if you go past their free 10 GB, billed to your own Cloudflare account.

Can I get a refund?

Yes, within 7 days of buying. Email harshrawat.dev@gmail.com from the address you bought with and we’ll refund you, back to your original payment method. After 7 days, purchases can’t be refunded. Details are in the terms.

When can I start recording?

Right after you buy. Add the Chrome extension, connect your Cloudflare from the dashboard (one click, we handle the rest), and click the Showthrough icon to record.

Black Friday: $49, not $99.

$49 once, with every future update, until Black Friday, 27 November, 11:59 PM PT. From our Product Hunt launch it's $99, without future updates.
